title: Princess Leia
description: PRINCESS LEIA, while always strong-willed, develops into much more ot an adventurer in RETURN OF THE JEDI. A flowing regal gown simply wouldn't do for the rough-and-tumble action on Endor. Leia's rebel foot soldier outfit (front) is topped with poncho and hard hat for the thrill-a-second speeder bike chase. The costumes for the film were designed by Aggie Guerard Rodgers and Nilo Rodis-Jamero, and were sketched by Rodis-Jamero.
